Blowin' In The Wind: Long-Term Downwind Exposure to Air Pollution from Power Plants and Adult Mortality
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We estimate the causal effects of long-term exposure to air pollution emitted from fossil fuel power plants on adult mortality. We leverage quasi-experimental variation in daily wind patterns, which is further instrumented by the county orientation from the nearest power plant. We find that the county’s fraction of days spent downwind of plants within 20 miles in the last 10 years is associated with increased mortality from COVID-19 through the third peak in mortality in January 2021. This effect is more pronounced in fenceline communities with high poverty rates, low health insurance coverage, and low educational attainment.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了长期暴露于化石燃料发电厂排放的空气污染对成年人死亡率的因果效应。我们利用日常风向的准实验性变化，并以最近发电厂的县地理朝向作为工具变量。研究发现，过去10年中，一个县位于20英里范围内发电厂下风向的天数比例，与2021年1月第三次死亡高峰之前的COVID-19死亡率上升有关。这一效应在贫困率较高、医疗保险覆盖率较低、教育水平较低的沿“栅栏线”社区中更为显著。

title: Springing Forward and Falling Back on Health: The Effect of Daylight Saving Time on Acute Myocardial Infarction
North-South Displacement Effects of Environmental Regulation: The Case of Battery Recycling
abstract: This study examines the effect of a tightening of the US air quality standard for lead in 2009 on the relocation of battery recycling to Mexico and on infant health in Mexico. In the United States, airborne lead dropped sharply near affected plants, most of which were battery-recycling plants. Exports of used batteries to Mexico rose markedly. In Mexico, production increased at battery-recycling plants relative to comparable industries, and birth outcomes deteriorated within two miles of those plants relative to areas slightly farther away. The case provides a salient example of a pollution-haven effect between a developed and a developing country. (JEL F18, I12, J13, O15, Q51, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2009年美国对铅的空气质量标准收紧，对电池回收业向墨西哥转移以及对墨西哥婴儿健康的影响。在美国，受影响工厂（其中大多数为电池回收厂）附近的空气铅含量急剧下降。废旧电池向墨西哥的出口显著增加。在墨西哥，电池回收厂的产量相对于可比产业有所增长，而距离这些工厂两英里范围内的出生结局，相较于稍远地区出现了恶化。该案例为发达国家与发展中国家之间的“污染避风港”效应提供了一个典型例证。（JEL F18, I12, J13, O15, Q51, Q53, Q58）
